messages:
emily: Heads up — our scanner flagged a KMS proxy log in eu-west-1 containing a plaintext key identifier during a rotation window. looks like replication to other shards happened before rewrap finished.
rahul: ugh. can you paste the exact log line? need to confirm if any key material leaked or just metadata.
emily: log snippet (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-19T22:17:04Z] proxy: POST /v1/keys/unwrap body={"key_id":"arn:redwood:kms:eu:key/abc123", "ciphertext":"<redacted>"} headers={...}
```
emily: scanner flagged because `key_id` ended up in a debug dump that was forwarded to the observability pipeline for 30s. no ciphertext shown in the dump.
devsec-elliot: if only key_id (ARN) was exposed that's metadata, still sensitive for BYOK customers. must treat as potential data exposure under BYOK contract and GDPR if tied to a controller.
ops-maria: immediate steps: 1) disable cross-region replication for that key shard 2) create a temporary RBAC role with minimal rotate-only perms 3) force rewrap/rotate the affected key version 4) blacklist the exposed key version so it can't be used for new encrypt ops
rahul: +1. propose `redwood-kmsctl lock-replication --shard eu-west-1` and `redwood-kmsctl rotate --key arn:...:abc123 --force --ephemeral-wrap`. Anyone object to doing that now?
emily: going to run the replication lock now. I'll annotate the audit log with reason `emergency rotation - metadata exposure` when done.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-042 (severity: P1) by emily — responders: oncall-sre, devsec.
devsec-elliot: also: we need to add an audit-export to a WORM bucket for forensic timeline and set retention to preserve until legal sign-off. Run `auditctl export --since 2026-03-19T21:30Z --to s3://ir-preserve/INC-2026-042`
legal-joan: notify compliance: this is potentially reportable. Supervisory authority timeline (GDPR) is 72 hours after becoming aware. We should draft a customer notification template in case scope increases. Do not promise public timing until we triage.
ops-maria: RBAC change plan: create role `kms:rotation-temp` scoped to `arn:...:shard/eu-west-1` with actions `[kms:Rewrap, kms:Rotate]`, assign to `oncall-sre` and `devsec` only, expire in 2 hours. We'll add an audit hook to deny `kms:ExportKeyMaterial` for that role.
rahul: question: will rotation break in-flight sessions? need to ensure UX for hosted customers — route fallback to alternate keys if necessary. add canary and monitor 5xx rates.
emily: noted. adding canary route and throttling policy to avoid cascading failures.
devsec-elliot: vuln triage note: snapshot the proxy binary and any klog config that caused the debug dump. Mark as root cause: `proxy: debug=true` accidentally enabled during a rare hotfix deploy. We need a post-deploy check to ensure debug flags are off in prod.
emily: I found a deploy job that sets `PROXY_DEBUG=true` for eu cluster when run with `--debug-hotfix`. I'll open a ticket to remove the flag from the hotfix wrapper.
legal-joan: create compliance ticket and include whether any customer identifiers are present. If no customer PII, note nevertheless BYOK contract clause about metadata exposure.
ops-maria: action items (owner in parens): lock replication (emily), create rotation role (rahul), run rotate & blacklist (rahul), export audit (devsec-elliot), snapshot artifacts (devsec-elliot), draft notice (legal-joan), post-deploy fix (emily). ETA 3 hours for initial containment.
emily: containment done: replication locked at 2026-03-19T22:28Z, rotation started. will post rotation result once complete.
rahul: once rotate done, we should run a targeted eval to ensure quantized model serving keys unaffected — test suite `infra/kms/rotate-regression`
devsec-elliot: also update SIEM rule: alert on any `key_id` appearing in debug logs from proxy. Create an automated rule to redact key ARNs at ingestion.
legal-joan: keep me posted before customer comms. we might need to coordinate with privacy and account teams for impacted customers.
incident-bot: INC-2026-042 updated: status=contained, next=forensic analysis, priority=P1.
emily: rotation succeeded 2026-03-19T23:05Z, old version blacklisted. No evidence of ciphertext/exposed material. Audit export completed to s3://ir-preserve/INC-2026-042.
ops-maria: follow-up items: 1) remove `PROXY_DEBUG` hotfix wrapper (emily) 2) add pre-deploy check `deny-if-debug=true` (devsec-elliot) 3) schedule RBAC review to avoid oncall role creep (rahul) 4) update runbook to include cross-region replication lock step (ops)
devsec-elliot: I'll raise a PR for redaction at ingestion and add a unit test for the logging sanitizer.
legal-joan: drafting compliance timeline. we will not notify customers yet; keep record in case scope changes.
emily: ok closing thread for now — will follow up with postmortem draft once we finish forensic analysis.
